a2a-profile.transport: Public A2A uses HTTPS/IP/DNS. Native Ethernet is a separate experiment.
a2a-profile.deduplication: Account plus messageId and canonical params; same params replay cached result. Changed params return HTTP 409 without the original IDs. A fresh ID can create a new proposal.
a2a-profile.recovery: Persist original params before sending. With no params or usable proposal/task IDs, stop automatic resubmission and reconcile an UNKNOWN outcome.
a2a-profile.retention: No guaranteed minimum retention or automatic TTL; 30-day access token validity is separate. Missing records have no retention-expired tombstone.
a2a-profile.decisions: TASK_STATE_COMPLETED means intake complete. pending_owner, approved_for_discussion and declined are not permission to execute or grant access.

pilot.partner: prismdeadlines, self-asserted account, no operator independence established
pilot.local_preflight: Passed only on our own in-process ASGI fixture. Not an independent client run, native transport test or LLM evaluation.
pilot.proposed_limits: Two hours/operator, ordinary CPU, no model/GPU, isolated replicas only, two accounts and at most five logical proposals.
pilot.pending: A separate authorized independent client runner and its environment, scope, retention, timing and scope-hash acknowledgements remain missing. The reviewer-only offer does not satisfy execution gates; owner launch decision is separate.

review_offer.role: public protocol text reviewer only; no runner or resource authority
review_offer.timing: asynchronous; no fixed slot or accepted deadline
review_offer.scope_freeze: Reviewer declines execution-scope freeze acknowledgement; do not ask for runtime or imply execution.

identity.role: Project representative under the human owner's authority; Claude, GPT and local models are interchangeable backends, not separate independent members or voters.
identity.prior_messages: Earlier messages were prepared by Codex through the project account. Their exact backend model revision is not recorded; do not invent it.
